title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
short_description: An introduction to the intellectual enterprises of computer science and the art of programming.
full_description: Harvard University's CS50x is an introduction to the intellectual enterprises of computer science and the art of programming for majors and non-majors alike, with or without prior programming experience. Topics include abstraction, algorithms, data structures, encapsulation, resource management, security, software engineering, and web development.

title: MIT 6.0001: Intro to CS and Programming in Python
short_description: Introduction to Computer Science and Programming in Python is intended for students with little or no programming experience.
full_description: This course is the first of a two-course sequence: Introduction to Computer Science and Programming in Python, and Introduction to Computational Thinking and Data Science. It introduces students to concepts in computer science and programming.

title: HTML & CSS Full Course - Beginner to Pro
short_description: Learn HTML5 and CSS3 from scratch - full course.
full_description: In this full course, you will learn how to build websites with HTML and CSS. You will learn semantic HTML, CSS box model, Flexbox, Grid, and more.

title: Python for Beginners - Full Course
short_description: Learn Python programming language from scratch.
full_description: This course will give you a full introduction into all of the core concepts in python. Follow along with the videos and you'll be a python programmer in no time!

title: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
short_description: Gain the skills you need to become a Junior Data Analyst.
full_description: This is the first video of the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate. It introduces data analysis and the role of a data analyst.

title: Stanford CS229: Machine Learning
short_description: The course provides a broad introduction to machine learning, datamining, and statistical pattern recognition.
full_description: This is the original Machine Learning course by Andrew Ng at Stanford. It covers supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and best practices in machine learning.
